name: Barbary Pirate Menace
text: For Ships and other items adjacent to the marked areas: Ports: 1 per Tax Value Controlled, ignoring own starting Provinces (these count as 1/2). Per Merchant: 2. Per Pirate: Christian PRs lose 2 prestige, Muslim PRs score 2 prestige. Per Ship: 1.

name: Imperial Balance of Power
text: PRs score 1 prestige for each NPR in Battleground Areas where they are the only PR to have 3 or more influence. PRs do not score any prestige for their own starting Core Provinces.

name: Defying Destiny
text: PRs ignore their starting Provinces. They score 3 prestige if valid in the marked area at or above the listed target, and lose 3 prestige if not. Age II: Initial Tax x1. Age III: Initial Tax x2. Age IV: Initial Tax x3.

name: Silk Route Rivalry
areas: all areas adjacent to samarkand and khiva on the india & arabia and northern & central asia maps
text: The PR with the most Units in the Battleground Areas scores 3 prestige. If Great Horde or Persia have fewer than 3 units, or Muscovy fewer than 2 units, in these Areas, they lose 3 prestige.

name: Race For El Dorado
areas: all distant areas with gold provinces on the america, africa, and india & arabia maps
text: The PRs with the most Heavy Ships in the Distant Continents and the most money in their Treasury (after deductions) each score 3 prestige. The PRs with the least each lose 3 prestige.

name: Lord of the Pontic Steppes
areas: all areas adjacent to eastern ukraine
text: PRs ignore their own starting Core Provinces. If Muscovy, Novgorod, Lithuania, Poland, or Great Horde has valid units in fewer than 2 of these Areas, they lose 3 prestige.

name: Struggle for the Balkans
text: The PR with the most Units in the Battleground Areas scores 3 prestige. If Ottomans or Austria have fewer than 6 units in these Areas, or Poland fewer than 4 units, they lose 3 prestige.

name: Distant Trade
areas: areas adjacent to the indian ocean trade node
areas adjacent to the east indies trade node
areas adjacent to the china & japan trade node
text: PRs score 2 prestige for each of those Trade Nodes where only they have an adjacent town. If France, Castile, or England has units adjacent to fewer than 2 of these Nodes, they lose 3 prestige.

name: The Holy League
text: PRs only score prestige for qualifying units with Realms that have the same State Religion as them. If Castile, Austria, or Ottomans has units in fewer than 2 of these Areas, they lose 3 prestige.

name: The Italian Wars
text: The Papal Controller scores 2 prestige. If France, Castile, or Austria has units in fewer than 2 of these Areas, they lose 3 prestige.

name: Thirty Years’ War
text: If 3 or more Elector Areas are Catholic, increase imperial authority by 1; if fewer, decrease it by 2. Then, the Emperor scores prestige equal to 2 x imperial authority - 4. Their Allies score or lose half of this.

name: Great Northern War
text: If Poland, Sweden, Denmark, or Muscovy has units in fewer than 3 of these Areas, they lose 3 prestige.

name: The Deluge
text: Poland loses prestige equal to the total Tax Value of the opponent's units in these Areas. If any PR adjacent to Poland has units in fewer than 2 of these Areas, they lose 3 prestige.

name: War of Spanish Succession
text: PRs with the qualifying alliance with Castile, or 6 or more units adjacent to the North America Trade Node, score 3 prestige. If Castile, France, or England has units in fewer than 3 of these Areas, they lose 3 prestige.

name: Napoleonic Wars
text: PRs only score prestige for Areas where they had no Core Provinces at the start of the game. PRs score 5 prestige if they Occupy the Capital of an Opponent.

name: Seven Years’ War
text: PRs score 2 prestige for each Distant Trade Node where they are the only PR to have an adjacent Port, and 2 prestige for each Distant Trade Node where they are the only PR with adjacent Ships.

name: Race for the Riches of India
text: If a PR is the only PR to have towns among the Battleground Areas, they score 5 prestige. PRs with no towns, vassals, alliances, royal marriages, or Military Units on the INDIA & ARABIA map, lose 3 prestige.
